facts_of_case: Appeal against the Judgment and Decree dated 26-3-2015 passed in OS No. 197 of 2009 on the file of the XII Additional District Judge, Krishna at Vijayawada.

legal_principles.principle: A compromise decree is barred by law under Order 23 Rule 3ACPC.
legal_principles.held: to set aside a compromise decree, which was barred by law under Order 23 Rule 3ACPC.
applicable_acts_sections: Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 — Order 23 Rule 3

legal_principles.principle: The admission is the best evidence.
legal_principles.held: submitting further that the admission is the best evidence.
cited_cases: C.N. Ramappa Gowda vs C.C. Chandregowda (died) by LRs and another

legal_principles.principle: The plaintiff has to still prove his plaint case.
legal_principles.held: but, merely because of that reason, the suit could not be decreed, The plaintiff had to still prove his plaint case.
cited_cases: C.N. Ramappa Gowda vs C.C. Chandregowda (died) by LRs and another

outcome.final_order: The appeal is allowed and the judgment and decree dated 26-3-2015 passed in OS No. 197 of 2009 are set aside.
